title: AOR-Bench accepted at EMNLP 2026
summary: Do large audio language models over-refuse pseudo-harmful queries? AOR-Bench measures the over-refusal failure mode in speech-facing safety alignment. Main conference, Budapest.

title: Lost in Speech accepted at SALMA 2026
summary: Trilingual spoken hallucination detection across audio and transcripts, at the 2nd Workshop on Speech and Audio Language Models, co-located with EMNLP 2026 in Budapest.

title: SDG prediction paper published in Journal of Open Innovation
summary: A hybrid Bayesian Belief Network and Artificial Neural Network approach for predicting Sustainable Development Goal outcomes from country-level AI readiness indicators.

title: SEAL Lab launches at CU Boulder
summary: The Secure and Ethical AI Lab formally begins operations. Recruiting PhD students, postdocs, and undergrad researchers.

title: BLUFF presented at KDD 2026
summary: Benchmarking falsehoods in long-tail multilingual low-resource languages, in the Datasets and Benchmarks Track at KDD 2026 in Jeju, South Korea.

title: ICML 2026 Position Paper accepted
summary: Our position paper — Breaking the Dual Curse of Multilingual AI — argues that multilingual safety cannot be retrofitted through post-hoc alignment.

title: DIA-HARM wins ACL 2026 Social Impact Paper Award 🏆
summary: Recognized at the 64th ACL for advancing equity in harmful-content detection across 50 English dialects.
